title: The next workout without guesswork
description: See the next session calculated by the rules of the program you chose, and change the suggestion before you start.

blocks.text: An automatic suggestion for the next session is convenient when a person understands how it relates to the program they chose and to their latest records.

quote.text: Easy to follow the program when it auto-adjusts your weight to lift, and you can custom it to increase faster or slower as needed.

blocks.text: Before the start, show the next version and how it differs from the previous one: the content, the values, the order. Keep the ability to check the original records and to correct the suggestion, marking whether a change applies to one session or to the rest of the plan.
Test consistency rather than promise a result

First make sure the app follows the rules it states and doesn’t change the plan after a mistaken mark or an update. That is a test of how the product behaves; athletic effectiveness requires separate grounds.
